mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.date, r.mood, r.diary, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM sj_day_record r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND ( r.diary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sj_learning_item i WHERE i.record_id = r.id AND ( i.subject LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.note LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ) ) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
